_comment: Routine action kind `pipeline` (mchatai_macOS/docs/ROUTINES_ARCHITECTURE.md §3.3). Runs in the app through the live AI Automation view model or the headless executor. A missing pipeline is failed: actionUnavailable; a pipeline paused after failures is skipped: breakerOpen (§8).
summary: Run one of your pipelines on a schedule.
help: Runs a saved pipeline (or a built-in template, by name) inside mChatAI+. If mChatAI+ is closed when it is due, it runs when the app next opens. Pipelines share one lane, so a pipeline that is due while another runs waits its turn.

templateName.title: Template
templateName.description: A built-in pipeline template, by name, when no saved pipeline is given.

input.title: Input
input.description: Text passed to the pipeline's first step. Optional.
